en.title: 'Woman Unknown' wins Golden Lion, Malkovich 'humbled' by best actor award at Venice Film Festival
en.summary: 'Woman Unknown,' a Danish drama directed by May el-Toukhy, won the Golden Lion at the 83rd Venice Film Festival. John Malkovich received the best actor award for his role in 'Wild Horse Nine' and acknowledged the honor via video message from Montreal.

stories.title: S. Korea holds emergency security meeting after North Korea fires ballistic missiles

en.title: S. Korea holds emergency security meeting after North Korea fires ballistic missiles
en.summary: South Korea's National Security Office convened an emergency meeting with defense agencies after North Korea launched multiple short-range ballistic missiles from Wonsan toward the East Sea. The missiles traveled approximately 250 kilometers, with the launch detected around 5:20 a.m.

en.summary: North Korea launched multiple ballistic missiles toward the East Sea early Saturday morning, one day following the conclusion of trilateral military exercises involving South Korea, the United States, and Japan near the Korean Peninsula.

en.title: N. Korea Fires Ballistic Missiles toward East Sea
